mostWorthwhile.text: Following the liver signal through to glucose release showed how a store can supply blood between meals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the hormones was straightforward but repetitive; the placements themselves did not show a biological effect.

surprise.text: It stood out that insulin stays outside the muscle cells and acts as a message rather than becoming part of the stored carbohydrate.

arbitrary.text: The required hormone placements felt a little like extra interface steps, although their destinations made sense from the pictures.

continue.text: I might continue to see how other body systems are regulated, though I would hope for fewer repetitive placement steps.
